title: dot ai fleet status v1 (one host's live agent sessions)
description: Printed by `dot ai status --fleet --json`, one line per host: this machine first, then each host in fleet.toml. A host that did not answer has reachable false and the reason. Metadata only: never a prompt or an answer.

host.description: This machine's short hostname, or the host's name in fleet.toml

error.description: Why the host did not answer (ssh's first line of error); empty when it did

event.description: The session's last state, a cli/agent-event.v1 record (schemas/cli/agent-event.v1.schema.json)

cost_usd.description: What the session cost (dot ai cost show); null when the host has no cockpit or no figure
